record.question: A solid right prism $ABCDEF$ has a height of $16$ and equilateral triangle bases with side length $12,$ as shown. $ABCDEF$ is sliced with a straight cut through points $M,$ $N,$ $P,$ and $Q$ on edges $DE,$ $DF,$ $CB,$ and $CA,$ respectively. If $DM=4,$ $DN=2,$ and $CQ=8,$ determine the volume of the solid $QPCDMN.$

original_record.subject: solid geometry

inventory: Equilateral triangular prism, top ABC and bottom EFD; eight source boundary edges, EF omitted; cut quadrilateral QPNM dashed; ten point labels, top edge12 and side16.
explicit_conditions: Base edge12, height16; DM4, DN2, CQ8; section plane through MNPQ.
layout_choices: All cut points exact and coplanar; no dots or new EF hidden edge.

answer_check.reasoning: Coplanarity gives CP=4. Cross-section at fraction t along height has sides4(1+t),2(1+t), included60°; integrate 2√3(1+t)² over16 gives224√3/3.
